description: Ongoing Feedback (☰ → Ongoing Feedback, a tab of Baude's and Record's main area): the list of feedback and its fixes, one shown with what can be done about it.

messages.send_tip: Say it on the issue, and fix it again
messages.stop_tip: Stop the fix running on this machine
messages.discard_tip: Discard the fix: its PR closed, its branch deleted, the feedback still open
messages.merge_tip: Merge PR #{$number}: every running Baude and Record updates to it
messages.fix_tip: Fix it on this machine, on branch fix/{$key}
messages.filed_unreadable: Filed as an issue, but it can't be read from GitHub here just now, so this is only the note saved here.
messages.draft: PR #{$number} is a draft: in progress.
messages.write_access: Only people with write access to {$repo} can fix or merge.
messages.fix_failed: The last fix here didn't go ahead: {$why}
messages.merge_body: PR #{$number} goes into main, and every running Baude and Record updates itself from main.
messages.discard_body: PR #{$number} is closed and its branch deleted. The feedback stays open.
messages.not_connected_body: Feedback lives on GitHub. Sign the gh CLI in (gh auth login) on a checkout of Baude from GitHub, and it shows here.
messages.only_saved_here: GitHub isn't connected: only what's saved here
